title: Critique: simulating a mind is not having one, and only brainlike causal powers make a mind

statements.text: No one supposes a computer simulation of a fire will burn the neighborhood down, so there is no reason to suppose a simulation of understanding understands. Only machines with the same causal powers as brains could think. Intentionality is a biological phenomenon, as dependent on its specific biochemistry as lactation or photosynthesis.
